title: BBQ Oven Pork Ribs
ingredients: 15g paprika, garlic & onion powder, herbs, salt, pepper
steps: Rub spice mix onto ribs; marinate 20 mins.
Bake covered with cider at 160°C for 90 mins.
Uncover, drizzle oil, bake at 180°C for 15 mins.
Simmer sauce ingredients for 45 mins until thickened.
Brush ribs with sauce and bake, flipping repeatedly for glaze.
